name: Run trace shows the skills block of the prompt assembly
description: Open the seeded PR #483 (refund endpoint with a happy-path test), switch to Agent runs, open the seeded run's Trace drawer, expand Prompt assembly, and confirm the 'Skills (dynamic)' block renders next to System and User / diff WITH its numeric '~N tokens' attribution label (both asserted together by the final wait --fn). The seeded run's trace was persisted with the four test-quality skills' composed block and its skills_tokens, so this pins the run-trace rendering and token attribution end to end without any model call. The expand itself is a guarded wait --fn (agent-browser coordinate clicks silently miss below the fold, and the section's children stay unmounted while collapsed). Labels are DOM-cased ('Prompt assembly', 'Skills (dynamic)'); never locate on Badge content.

cmd: Add refund endpoint with happy-path test
steps.label: open the seeded experiment PR #483
switch to the Agent runs tab
runs tab active in the URL
the seeded run's agent row renders

cmd: () => { const el = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('span')).find((s) => s.textContent === 'Prompt assembly'); if (!el) return false; if (document.body.innerText.includes('User / diff')) return true; el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); el.closest('div').click(); return false; }
steps.label: expand the collapsed Prompt assembly section (guarded click — coordinate clicks miss below the fold)

cmd: () => { const t = document.body.innerText; return t.includes('Skills (dynamic)') && /~\d+ tokens/i.test(t); }
steps.label: the skills block shows both its title and its ~N token count (--text only sees the drawer's visible scroll viewport; innerText does not)
